notes: `עַשְׁתֵּי עָשָׂר` → *eleventh* is a single English word carrying both morphemes, so they fuse under rule 30, headed on the governing first morpheme (rule 23).
No article morpheme stands in this verse, so the *the* is supplied and joins the substantival numeral's own unit under rules 15 and 31; the numeral writes no noun for the determiner to stand on.
